list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as published; hidden flags and PSN counts follow those listings. GTA VI released today, so every guide here is written from the official description and is marked not yet checked in the game.
sources_note: Sources: official list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count); our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. Follow the roadmap in this guide: story first, then side strands, then collectibles and the long grinds last. Not yet checked in the game.
